ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with an approximate 75:25 ratio of dark to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized in mottling and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are organized into localized circular nodes across the medial lobe regions, with dense, fine-grained grey-scale mottling concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; the base vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence, but the converging lobe boundaries indicate a deep, narrow angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases toward the distal tips, showing irregular jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins, sweeping upward and outward from the central axis to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (approximately 12-15 distinct nodes) scattered across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal linear disruption on the mid-left lobe and a prominent diagonal white slash on the inner-right lobe near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular protrusions at both the left and right distal tips, featuring high-texture, yellowish-brown pixel clusters indicative of heavy parasitic encrustation or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of unique 'donut-shaped' or ring-like white pigment patterns localized on the right lobe surface.
